summary: grafana.grafana in 11.2.0 allows a custom directory for .alloy config files, fixes 'dict object has no attribute path' in check mode, updates the grafana template, adds Loki bloom support and supports YAML syntax for grafana.ini.
questions: Can I change where the Alloy role writes its .alloy config files?
Why do I get 'dict object has no attribute path' with --check in the grafana collection?
Does the Loki role support bloom filters?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana changes in 11.2.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- Custom directory path for `*.alloy` config files.
- Fix for `'dict object' has no attribute 'path'` in `--check` runs.
- Loki bloom support.
- YAML syntax for `grafana.ini` settings, plus template updates.
